content: Samuwela Isileli I Ba Pagasisel
Inoke Samuwela i baek Isileli gegewel elal i ba, “Iyaka ya ginol i ola wami awanun eliyau ge gamagal etega ya teli iya wami kin.
He wami kin o sauga ya i houwaagimiu. Nau iyaka ya liki kaunu i puwi, he natuwau bolau heliya iyahe alomiyau. I telipunaa no sauga heval ana siga lan ebe nau ya houwaagimiu.

He sauga ya ya talmilil awomiwa. Inoke ebo bugul etega ya ginol panak, yaka nuku ba pamasal Yehoba ge wana hilihili kin mataliyaa. Tab gamagal etega wana bulumwakau ya ahe? O, age etega wana donki ya ahe? Tab gamagal etega ya kakawe ge wana gogomwau ya ahe? O, age etega ana hehegan ya apapanak-an? Tab kakawi manina ya ahe gamagal etega elana inoke nige ana lahi ya giginol? Ebo bugul bolo o etega ya ginol, he no wasa nuku pem yaka na abubun.”
Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Nige u kakakawema ge wama gogomwau u aahe, o ebo ama hehegan u aapapanak-an. Ge nige kakawi manina u aahe gamagal etega elana.”

Inoke Samuwela i baek elal i ba, “Yehoba alona ge wana hilihili kin wami baaba o iyaka lan ebe hi hago, inoke nihi patunahot te nige no ginol nanakina etega ku pwapwawa.” Yaka anana hi lahe hi ba, “E. I ola. Yehoba wama baaba o iyaka i hago.”
Inoke Samuwela i ba vevehe al gamagalau elal i ba, “Yehoba te Mosese ge Eloni i hilel. Iya te tubulau i ahel hi tagilem Itipita.
He nuku talmilil Yehoba matanaa, yaka ginol bwabwatal bolo i ginolil tubulau kaiweliya ge komiu kaiwemiu na liwanagil. Inoke eliyana wami gegi na pamasal eliyamiu, kaiwena nuwamiu kin.

“He Yakobo alonau natunau ge tubunau hi na Itipita. Baliman hi gewi i mowasi abwe Itipita boda Isileli hi papalomwan-agil, yaka labe kaiwena hi yoga ha Yehoba elana inoke Mosese ge Eloni i patunal elal. Yaka tubulau hi ahel hi tagilem Itipita ge hi nulil hi nem hi miminaa labi ya elana.

“Yaa Yehoba, iya tubulau wali Yabowaine, hi nuluwan. Inoke sauga ali topihigelgel hi nem hi lohaveyan elal, yaka i tatalamwagil nimaliyaa. Ali topihigelgel etegana Sisila, panuwa Heisol wali tolohaveyan wali tohouwa, etegana boda Pilistiya, ge etegana labi Mowabi wali kin.

Inoke sauga maisena ge maisena tubulau labe kaiwena hi yoyoga ha Yehoba elana hi babaa, ‘Ama iyaka ha gegi, kaiwena am en ha pewa ha kukululuek yabowaine gogoginol Bal ge Astolet elal. He nu pwamwalima ama topihigelgel nimaliyaa, yaka naha kululu elam.’

Yaka sauga maisena ge maisena Yehoba gamagal etega i papatuna, etegana Gidiyon, etegana Belaki, etegana Yepta, ge etegana nau Samuwela. Inoke Yehoba i pwamwalimiu ami topihigelgel nimaliyaa ge ku mibubun.

“Yaa sauga Nahas, Amoli wali kin, alonau wana tolohaveyan hi nenem nihi lohaveyan eliyamiu, yaka bwagana Yehoba wami Yabowaine iya wami kin, he ku baem eliyau ku ba, ‘Nigeya! Nuwama wama kin ni gan ge ni logugui-agima.’
He kin toto ku hile iya hiwe. Ku awanuni, he iya Yehoba iyaka i teli wami kin ge ni logugui-agimiu.
Ebo Yehoba nuku lovakunan yaka nuku tapwalolo elana, wana baaba nuku hago ge nige wana logugui nuku totowani, ge ebo alomiu wami kin Yehoba wana kamwasa nuku toulil, inoke nuku mibubun.
Yaa ebo nige wana baaba nuku hahago ge ebo wana logugui nuku towani, yaka wana gasisi elana ni apapanak-agimiu ni ola valila tubulau i apapanak-agil.
“He nuku talmilil, yaka ginol bwabwatana etega Yehoba i giginol matamiwa nuku kite ni ola hiwe.

Sauga ya witi tomwatomwa ana sauga. Ge ku atena kila wala labiya nige kehe ana sauga i oola. Yaa nau na awanun Yehoba elana panuwa ni pagulumwawa ge ni lokehe. Ebo ni ginol ola o, yaka abwe nuku atena te sauga ku awanun wami kin ni gan, he iyaka ku gegi Yehoba matanaa.”
Yaka Samuwela i awanun Yehoba elana, inoke lan o panuwa i pagulumwawa ge i lokehe. Inoke gamagalau gegewel Yehoba ge Samuwela hi lovakunagil.

Yaka gegewel hi baek Samuwela elana hi ba, “Nu awanun Yehoba wam Yabowaine elana ama wam totuwalali kaiwema yaka bahi naha aaliga. Kaiwena wama gegi ona iyaka ha paetulan te ha awanun wama kin ni gan.”
Analiya Samuwela i lahe i ba, “Bahi lovakun! Tunahot gegi bolo ya ku ginolil. Yaa bahi al Yehoba ana en nuku pepek, nuku kululu elana alona ge atemiu bwalibwaligena.
Bahi Yehoba nuku eeguluwan ge nuku kukululuek yabowaine gogoginol elal. Heliya bugul bwagabwaga hot, nige bugul waiwaisana etega nihi giginol kaiwemiu ge nige nihi pwapwamwalimiu.
Yehoba wana yaliyaya elana i hilemiu iya wana gamagalau. Inoke komiu nige ni teteli yohimiu, kaiwena ebo ni ginol ola, he totona alana ni papuluwawi-an to.
Ge nau nige na babakuhu awaawanun kaiwemiu, kaiwena ebo na bakuhu, he iyaka ya gegi Yehoba elana to. I ola al, kamwasa waiwaisana ge sasapona na pankitemiu ge eliyana nuku nanawaa.
Yehoba wana ginol bwabwatal bolo i ginolil kaiwemiu nuku nuwatuagil. Inoke nuku lovakunan ge nuku kululu tunahot elana ginebi ge atemiu bwalibwaligena.
Yaa ebo gegi nuku mimi awaawaginol, yaka alomiu wami kin Yehoba ni ahek yohimiu labi ya elana.”
